complete_number_projectors.all_input_identity: product of the complete spectral partitions of commuting group number operators N_g; tensor identity on the474-dimensional original reference and any extra reference
complete_number_projectors.exact_projector_formula: P_g,n=product_(ell!=n)(N_g-ell I)/(n-ell), ell=0..r_g for fermions and0..2 for capped bosons
complete_number_projectors.number_operator: sum beta_j^dagger beta_j over the actual joint eigenspace; beta are the parent canonical quasiparticle fields
complete_number_projectors.zero_rank_boson_outcome_rule: every vector in{0,1,2}^28 with totalcount>2 has the exact zero effect and exact zero probability
